## Safety, privacy and security

I have read my own code (or, if an AI helped, I have read what it wrote and understand it) and I confirm that:

- [ ] It only does what its description says, and nothing else.
- [ ] It does not collect, store or send personal data (names, email, location, browsing, keystrokes, files) except what is listed under "What it contacts" below, and that data is only what the feature needs.
- [ ] It has no analytics, tracking, advertising, cookies, or hidden network calls.
- [ ] It does not run code from the internet or from strings (`eval`, `new Function`, remote imports, `<script>` tags) and does not use `innerHTML` with outside data.
- [ ] It uses `api.storage` for saving data, and only talks to the websites listed below, over https.
- [ ] It contains no obfuscated or minified code, and no secrets or API keys.
- [ ] I wrote it, or I have the right to share it, and I am happy for it to be distributed with Ampere.
- [ ] I tested it in Chrome, in both light and dark themes, and removing it leaves nothing behind.
